Livestock Weighted Average Report for 10/21/2026 - Final

AUCTION
                                                          This Week                 Last Reported                    Last Year
                                                                                     10/14/2026
Total Receipts:                                          1,669                       2,180                         1,430
Feeder Cattle:                                             313(18.8%)                 594(27.2%)                        0(0.0%)
Slaughter Cattle:                                          359(21.5%)                 372(17.1%)                     514(35.9%)
Replacement Dairy Cattle:                                    0(0.0%)                     0(0.0%)                     137(9.6%)
Feeder Dairy Calves:                                       178(10.7%)                 202(9.3%)                         0(0.0%)
Slaughter Sheep/Lambs:                                     600(35.9%)                 751(34.4%)                     577(40.3%)
Slaughter Goats:                                           219(13.1%)                 261(12.0%)                     202(14.1%)

Compared to last week, slaughter steers were 8.00 lower and Holstein slaughter steers were 5.00 lower. Slaughter heifers were 6.00 lower
and Holstein slaughter heifers were 10.00 higher based on a limited comparison. Slaughter cows were 2.00 lower and Holstein slaughter
cows were 2.00 lower. Slaughter bulls were 11.00 lower and Holstein slaughter bulls were 4.00 higher. Choice/prime slaughter lambs were
mostly 16.00 higher with good demand. No comparison available on slaughter kids due to a limited comparison, but good demand was noted.
 Supply included: 19% Feeder Cattle (15% Dairy Steers, 19% Heifers, 52% Dairy Heifers, 15% Beef/Dairy Steers); 22% Slaughter Cattle (13%
Steers, 14% Dairy Steers, 20% Heifers, 7% Cows, 5% Bulls, 2% Dairy Heifers, 36% Dairy Cows, 3% Dairy Bulls); 11% Feeder Dairy Calves (98%
Bulls, 2% Heifers); 36% Slaughter Sheep/Lambs (86% Wooled & Shorn, 1% Shorn, 7% Hair Breeds, 5% Ewes, 1% Rams); 13% Slaughter Goats
(83% Kids, 11% Nannies/Does, 6% Bucks/Billies). Feeder cattle supply over 600 lbs was 3%.
